correctness.rationale: For a,b,c>0 and any compactly supported invariant probability μ of real Chen flow, test invariant generator L against antiderivatives of arbitrary continuous φ(x),ψ(y),θ(z): E[dot x|x]=E[dot y|y]=E[dot z|z]=0. Substituting dot x=a(y−x), dot y=cy−x(z+a−c), dot z=xy−bz yields all three asserted conditional regressions. Each centered speed residual is orthogonal to its predictor coordinate, so three exact Pythagorean variance defects and covariances follow with factors a,c,b exactly. If each speed defect separately vanishes, its coordinate is constant along trajectories in invariant support; the remaining linear stable equations force bounded complete trajectories to equilibria. For z-speed use u=x² satisfying dot u=2a(K−u) with K=xy=bz constant, and no non-equilibrium bounded complete solution. With x-speed or y-speed zero, similarly y=x or x=y via stable filter. If 2c≤a only origin is equilibrium; otherwise ±sqrt(b(2c−a)) at z=2c−a. Any non-equilibrium stationary state has positive variances/defects and three strictly interior (0,1) positive correlations. No physical measure existence claimed.
